title: Late Fall Halls Soirée
description: Late Fall Halls Soirée Thursday, December 4 6:30 – 8:30 PM Lower Hall Gallery & Great Hall Gallery | 50 Victoria Street, Aurora Celebrate the artists in our two hallway exhibitions, Forever-22 a solo exhibition by Julia Mobbs and What does a Winter’s Night Hold? in this combined public reception. Refreshments provided, and remarks to commence at 7pm. All are welcome. Forever-22 (Lower Hall Gallery): New works by local emerging artist Julia Mobbs, created in her Fall 2025 residency at the Aurora Cultural Centre. What Does a Winter’s Night Hold? (Great Hall Gallery): A group exhibition showcasing the skills of our very own Aurora Cultural Centre artist instructors.
